# unifi_network_ap_group (Resource)

A UniFi AP group — a named set of access points a `unifi_network_wlan` can broadcast on (v2 `/apgroups`). The controller ships a protected default group covering every adopted AP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `device_macs` (Set of String) MAC addresses of the access points in this group. Empty groups are allowed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
